game-rule-1-label-1: By investing game coupons to open long and open short, within the specified time (until the end of the game of police catching thieves), the execution of the opening and closing operations, if the position is not closed, it will be closed directly at the time cut-off line. The proceeds obtained through the game coupon can be withdrawn directly. After opening a position, the game coupon will be consumed. After closing a position, if the margin corresponding to the coupon is remaining, the coupon will not be refunded and the corresponding part of the coupon purchased with real money will be refunded.
game-rule-1-label-2: Time: Start time - the time when the user opens a position; End time - the end time of the game of police catching thieves, that is, the police catch thieves or thieves get prizes for the end of a game.
game-rule-1-label-3: Each game voucher, after placing a bet, generates a position with a fixed position value (100U), and the profit is real money, which can be withdrawn, where each voucher includes a commission.
game-rule-1-label-4: Positions are opened using a fixed leverage multiplier of 100x, each game coupon corresponds to the value of the position (100U)

rule-0-1:
Dear user,
Welcome to participate in our cryptocurrency exchange game event!
To show our appreciation for your support, the platform will airdrop 1000 game vouchers to each user, with a total value of up to 100K USDT, and these vouchers will be in a locked state.
Upon your first login each day, you will receive 2 free game vouchers. Additionally, you have the opportunity to earn more game vouchers by completing various tasks.
rule-0-2-1: Game vouchers can be used for trading purposes (they are consumed when opening positions but not when closing positions). <b>Each game voucher can open a position worth 100U. After closing the position, you can withdraw the profitable portion.
rule-0-2-2: Apart from earning game vouchers through tasks, you can also directly purchase them with USDT at a rate of 1 USDT = 1 game voucher, which will enhance your gaming experience.
rule-0-2-3: Once you use game vouchers to open positions, Mario and Kuba Battle will enter the game state. With each position opened or closed, Mario will accelerate forward, allowing you to acquire treasure chest rewards more quickly.
rule-0-3: Thank you for your interest and participation in our event. We wish you a joyful experience and abundant profits in the game! If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact our customer service team. (Provide customer service contact information here)
rule-1-0:
Dear user,
Welcome to participate in our Mario vs. Kuba Game Tournament! In this game, there are three elements:
rule-1-0-1: Kuba: Represents the disruptor of Crypto prosperity.
rule-1-0-2: Mario: Represents you and the contributor to Crypto's growth.
rule-1-0-3: Treasure Chest: Contains prizes that offer various rewards.
rule-1-1-1:
Kuba is 330 steps away from the treasure chest, Mario is 240 steps away, and there are 90 steps between Kuba and Mario.
Kuba's speed is 2 steps per second, while Mario's speed is 1 step per second.
The game begins with Kuba chasing Mario. Every time a user opens or closes a position, Mario accelerates towards the treasure chest.
The game ends when Kuba catches up to Mario or when Mario successfully reaches the treasure chest.
To add excitement and challenge to the game, we have established some special rules for Mario:
rule-1-1-1-1: Every time you open a position, Mario will accelerate forward by 10 steps.
rule-1-1-1-2: Every time you close a position, Mario will accelerate forward by 20 steps.
rule-1-1-1-3: When your closing profit is between 0% and 30%, Mario will accelerate forward an additional 20 steps. When your closing profit exceeds 30%, Mario will accelerate forward an additional 50 steps.
rule-1-1-2: This will make the game more thrilling. We hope you can earn more game rewards through strategic moves.
rule-1-1-title: At the start of the game
rule-1-2-1: Before Kuba catches up to Mario, Mario only needs to reach the treasure chest location to win the treasure chest. The number of treasure chests = the minimum number of game vouchers consumed in multiple rounds of opening and closing positions.
rule-1-2-2-2: Assuming the platform unlocks a bonus of 10k USDT, with 20% (2k USDT) of the bonus participating in this activity. There are three teams: A, B, and C. When Team A adds a new valid game user, a 60-minute countdown starts for Team A. If, when the timer reaches 45 minutes, Team B adds a new valid game user, the countdown for Team B is refreshed for 60 minutes. If there are no new valid game users added to Teams A, B, and C, then after the 60-minute timer triggered by Team B ends, Team B receives the 2k bonus. The team leader of Team B receives a bonus of 2k * 20% = 400 USDT, and the remaining portion of 2k - 400 = 1600 USDT is directly added to Team B's team prize pool, without being locked.
rule-1-2-3-1: Additionally, treasure chests are divided into regular chests and golden chests. As a reward for players, any user purchasing more than 10 game vouchers has a 100% chance to receive an additional golden chest when their game voucher consumption reaches the 20th, 30th, 50th, 80th, 130th, 210th, 340th, and 550th instances. The golden chest contains higher-value prizes.
rule-1-2-3-1-1: Prizes in Ordinary Chests include: game vouchers, USDT, team prize pool grand prize, platform prize pool grand prize.
rule-1-2-3-1-2: Prize in Golden Chests include: a large number of game vouchers, a large amount of USDT.
rule-1-2-4-1: Thank you for your attention and participation in our event. We wish you a pleasant experience and abundant rewards in the game!
rule-1-2-4-2: If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact our customer service team. (Provide customer service contact information here)
rule-2-1: The platform will set up a platform prize pool (500k USDT), and the initial bonuses will be in a locked state. It requires the collaborative efforts of all platform players to unlock the bonuses. After each bonus is unlocked, the unlocked portion of the bonus can be obtained by players through various activities.
rule-2-2-1:
After each stage of rewards is unlocked, a portion of the platform's prize pool will be allocated to players who contribute to the unlocking, according to the following formula:
The bonus each person receives after unlocking rewards in each stage = the rewards unlocked in the current stage x distribution ratio.
(Distribution ratio: the total number of game vouchers consumed by all level-one invites of the individual / the total number of game vouchers consumed across the entire platform).
rule-warning: To ensure the safety of your assets, please participate in the event cautiously, follow the exchange rules, and ensure the security of your account information.
